_comment: Landmark healthy-aging / geriatrics practice guidelines, stored as PubMed SEARCH QUERIES (topic + issuer/instrument keywords), NOT as identifiers. The real PMID is resolved by PubMed's guideline[pt]-filtered search at harvest time (src/pubmedharvest.ts harvestGuidelineCanon) — we never hardcode or invent a PMID/DOI. Each entry surfaces a well-known guideline so the core canon is guaranteed coverage; edit/extend freely.
